sourceChecks.title: Senolytics decrease senescent cells in humans: Preliminary report from a clinical trial of Dasatinib plus Quercetin in individuals with diabetic kidney disease
sourceChecks.excerpt: D + Q reduced adipose tissue senescent cell burden within 11 days
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Phase 1 open-label study of nine people with diabetic kidney disease reported reduced senescence markers in adipose and skin after dasatinib plus quercetin.
sourceChecks.limitations: Narrow short-term tissue-marker outcome, not complete/selective clearance of all senescent cells throughout the body or long-term safety. Independent review reopened and read original source snapshot; live availability not asserted.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: human senolytic phase 1 diabetic kidney disease trial

sourceChecks.title: Reprogramming to recover youthful epigenetic information and restore vision
sourceChecks.excerpt: restores youthful DNA methylation patterns and transcriptomes
sourceChecks.paraphrase: OSK expression in mouse retinal ganglion cells restored selected youthful methylation/transcriptome features and improved regeneration/vision in injury, glaucoma and old-mouse settings.
sourceChecks.limitations: Mouse retinal cells and tissues only; does not show safe systemic whole-body reprogramming or human-scale rejuvenation. Independent review reopened and read original source snapshot; live availability not asserted.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: partial reprogramming OSK restore vision aged mice PubMed

sourceChecks.title: Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice
sourceChecks.excerpt: dietary encapsulated rapamycin increases mouse survival
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Multisite study found late-life rapamycin extended median and maximum survival in genetically heterogeneous mice of both sexes.
sourceChecks.limitations: No safe single-agent human longevity result, no 50% healthy-lifespan extension, and survival may involve cancer delay and strain/context effects. Independent review reopened and read original source snapshot; live availability not asserted.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: late life rapamycin lifespan mouse primary study
